title: Help Needed! Make the player skid to a stop. RPG Maker MV .

posts.author: Evarcha
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I am sorry to come across as such a noob.
I am wanting my player/ship to slow to a stop when moving from tile-to-tile...kinda like a skid/inertia.
I find the movement rather sudden and the sudden stop when the destination is jarring, I'd like to be able to soften it if possible?

but have some idea's that I can work out, but cannot promise that.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Emm, just a question, how do you skid to stop in a grid based movement system?
Because the player can't stop between grids, like a pixel movement system.
For example you hold a direction key to move, then release it, there could be several situations:
1) The character just start moving from Grid A to B
2) The character already/almost in Grid B
3) Somewhere between A and B
For 1), you can make it move slower every frame until it is very slow, so it has the effect you desired;
For 2), nothing seems to happen, unless you want to force it to move another step forward to say, Grid C;
For 3), the effect is not too obvious, depends on the progress of the movement.

posts.author: rakanishoo
posts.body:
Strange it works in my project, with some minor issues that can't be prevented.
It works like this:
In RPG maker if you press an arrow character's x and y changes instantly but realX and realY stay the same. if realX is not equal to x or realY is not equal to y, the character moving animation kicks in and depending on speed param it moves character every few pixels each frame.
I'f player made 60% of its way I modify the speed to a lower one unless player stil holds arrow button.
So of course as you mentioned if player releases the button exactly at the right time, the skid will not kick in. but if player  presses button and then releases it or releases the button earler than moving 60% of the way, the slow down will happen.
Second way it works is when mouse button or touch is used, then the $gameTemp.DestinationX and Y are set. I then base on these number to determine when slowdown should happen.
Make sure you turn off all the plugins you are using when testing mine. Interference is possible so let me know with which plugins it interferes.
EDIT: When I copied the code to the forum I missed a closing bracket }. Added it now, sorry. Please try now.
